confirm_end: All participants will be removed from the room. This action cannot be undone.
summary_draft: AI-generated draft: check every claim. Source references support review but do not guarantee correctness.
error_summary_empty: No saved speech has permission for AI summarization.
error_summary_changed: The transcript changed during generation. Pause capture and try again.
transcript_partial: Automatic transcript. Includes only explicitly consenting speakers. Recognition and attribution may contain errors.
confirm_transcript: Delete all saved transcript entries and the summary for this meeting?
usage_note: Server request counts and provider-reported text tokens are separate from browser-reported audio. Estimates use the operator’s rate, exclude output audio and text, and are not verified billing. Provider quota is unavailable.
booking_lead: Review requests, calendar changes and notifications.
config_help: Edit private configuration on the server, then refresh. Credentials are never displayed here.
confirm_cancel: Cancel this booking and revoke its meeting invitation?
confirm_delete: Delete this meeting and its retained files and transcript? This cannot be undone.
confirm_rotate_links: Replace both invitation and host links? Previous links will stop working.
copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it manually.
dashboard_lead: Rooms, requests and the services behind them.
error_capacity: The limit cannot be lower than the live participant count.
error_disabled: This feature is disabled on this installation.
error_invalid: Check the entered values and try again.
error_provider: The external service is unavailable or its quota was reached.
error_rate: Too many requests. Please wait before retrying.
error_room_password: Room passwords must be at least 4 characters and no more than 72 bytes.
error_schedule: Check the schedule and expiry. The selected local time must exist.
error_session: Your session expired. Sign in again.
error_slot: That time is unavailable. Choose another slot.
error_summary: The provider returned a summary without usable supporting references.
error_sync: A provider operation is pending. Refresh and retry the same operation.
error_uncertain: The request timed out and may have completed. Refresh before retrying.
health_lead: Local configuration checks do not verify provider connectivity.
host_private: The host link grants meeting control. Share only the participant invitation with guests.
login_lead: Sign in to create rooms, manage requests and review configuration.
mail_failed: The request was saved, but some email notifications failed. Review and retry notifications.
media_unknown: The media service is unavailable. Live participant counts are unknown.
no_rooms: No matching rooms. Create a room to start.
no_slots: No available times. Check booking availability.
setup_needed: Set an administrator password on the server with php bin/set-admin.php.
sync_pending: Application state saved; media or calendar cleanup still needs synchronization.
title: Meeting title
